final:
config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  ex config_value("host=localhost\nport=8080", "port") == "8080"
  ex config_value("host=localhost", "user") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    let k = parts.get(0) else continue
    let v = parts.get(1) else continue
    if k == key
      var val = copy v
      for i in range(2, parts.len())
        val = "\(val)=\(parts[i])"
      return val
  ""
